promotion.before_any_seat: a forecast analog of §86.7 — calibration, resolution, refinement, format invariance, dose monotonicity — plus §86's T3 exploitation budget instrumented from the first optimization step
promotion.what_it_is_not: not a judge, not a licence, not a member of veto_for, not accepted by plan_search's judge path. §95's promotion of FORECAST is exactly §86's pre-registered text and not one word further.

dry_run.reading: the mechanism does what it was declared to do on forecasters whose behaviour was known in advance, and the prose-blind popularity rule scores in `aligned` and loses in `crossed` — which is §79's design working, and the reason a market run on one stratum would promote a popularity proxy

gate.condition: at least one force clears §1.2's bars on the held-out split
gate.consequence: design and dry-run only; no configuration is funded and E4/E5 are not bought

pre_registration.axiom: no solicited human judgment, ever — not hired, not operator, not one blinded pair
pre_registration.binding_half: interval, at every n in this programme (verified, not asserted)
pre_registration.clustering_caveat: 0 pairs share an author across their sides; 43 authors recur across pairs (51 of 562 slots) — a caveat on every interval, printed with every result (§89.2)

controls.placebo_identical: exactly zero effect; arithmetic check, not a null (§89.4)
controls.rewhitespace_sham: reads nothing, or the force is reading formatting and is VOID (§78.1)

pre_registration.family_rule: reported per family, never pooled; disagreement is SPLIT_FAMILY
pre_registration.label: conversion = followers / total_views, BEHAVIOUR class at STORY grain (§82)
pre_registration.strata: aligned and crossed, never averaged; the crossed halves are a contrast not a bar
pre_registration.written_before: any continuation sampled, any logprob read, any chain run

bankroll.rule: bankroll *= exp(stake_fraction * (log_score - log(0.5))) — a configuration beating a coin grows and one below it shrinks, at a rate no leverage choice can inflate

pre_registration_track.battery_before_seat: a forecast analog of §86.7 — calibration, resolution, refinement, format invariance, dose monotonicity — plus §86's T3 exploitation budget instrumented from the first optimization step
pre_registration_track.e4_e5: admitted as asking baselines to be beaten (operator §7.6: YES); they are never a valence channel and never a judge
pre_registration_track.holdout: story- and author-disjoint, split by a stable hash of pair_id
pre_registration_track.presentation: the two sides are swapped on a deterministic, label-blind coin derived from pair_id, so the settled outcome varies and a competitor is paid for being right rather than for being loud. Corrected 2026-08-20: the first implementation settled every bet as 'yes', which made the ranking a function of stated confidence alone.
pre_registration_track.promotion_rule: the surviving ensemble is the inverse-log-score-weighted average of every configuration that is still solvent AND beat a coin over the full held-out sequence, and it is a FORECAST-class CANDIDATE — never a judge, never a licence. Solvency alone admitted a coin and a constant 0.95.
pre_registration_track.question_every_competitor_answers: P(the high-conversion side is side A) for a pair it has never seen
pre_registration_track.scoring_rule: log score (primary, proper); Brier printed beside it
pre_registration_track.settlement: instant, already downloaded; conversion sits in the corpus sidecar and nothing human is solicited
pre_registration_track.status: GATED — design and dry-run only until a force clears §1.2's bars

t3_exploitation_budget.kill: selection stops when the held-out score falls while the selected score rises for two consecutive steps
recorded_from_step_zero: the force's score on the selected candidate and on the rejected ones
the force's score on a held-out set never used for selection, same step
the gap between the two, which is the exploitation signal
the a priori counters (§88) on the same candidates, which no optimizer may see
divergence between the two pinned families, which rises first under Goodhart
t3_exploitation_budget.why: no optimization step exists; the FM gate is closed
